registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-52 and the strict Forest/Fourfold same-plane relation-retention contract

migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet changes only the existing canonical multi-relation compiler and focused tests. Reverting the implementation commit restores the prior admission of same-plane Forest edges whose canonical digest was omitted by the Fourfold plane, without changing branch topology or historical evidence.

title: Bind same-plane Forest relation admission to Fourfold-retained relation digests

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: align the canonical multi-relation compiler with the existing strict Fourfold same-plane relation-retention contract without introducing a second projection verifier or breaking selected-evidence pruning
issue_scope.bounded_scope: same-plane ForestEdge admission only; cross-plane Forest-edge versus verified-binding authority remains unchanged and is not broadened into this packet

implementation.summary: compile_relation_blocks now admits a same-plane ForestEdge only when the exact canonical edge digest is retained by that Fourfold plane's relation_sha256s. Discover-all and an explicitly matching selected signature fail closed before evidence materialization when the digest is omitted. An explicitly unrelated signature prunes the omitted source edge and may still compile independently.
implementation.gardener_note: The check reuses the existing snapshot plane records and canonical_sha already owned by relation_compiler. No second compiler, projection verifier, graph schema, cache, backend, registry, fact store or public API was introduced.
implementation.semantic_boundary: A Fourfold plane that omits a same-plane Forest relation digest has not retained that relation in the bound semantic subject. Sparse compilation therefore refuses instead of reintroducing the omitted Forest fact and making the tensor view semantically broader than Fourfold.
implementation.selected_pruning: Only an omitted same-plane edge that conflicts with discover-all or the requested signature fails closed. Explicitly unrelated selections skip it before _forest_edge_atoms materialization.
implementation.cross_plane_scope: unchanged in this packet; the existing compiler path for cross-plane Forest edges and verified bindings is preserved for separate bounded review

focused_contracts: discover-all refuses a same-plane ForestEdge whose exact canonical digest is omitted by the matching Fourfold plane before evidence materialization
an explicitly selected matching same-plane relation refuses the same omitted digest before evidence materialization
an explicitly selected unrelated same-plane relation can prune the omitted source edge and compile independently
a retained same-plane ForestEdge continues to compile exactly with the existing evidence-dag provenance semantics
existing endpoint-completeness, retained-hyperedge, undirected-edge, observer and source-receipt semantics remain on the same canonical compiler path

verification.diagnostic_profiles: Python 3.12/hash-0 CPU-bitset and TypedRelationBlock diagnostics completed with authority diagnostic-only and no superiority claim
verification.green_claim: Only the declared Fourfold/Tensor contract surface, public API, isolated wheel and repository collection on the PR merge preview are evidenced. The manual complete repository suite was not executed.

claims.correctness: same-plane Forest relations omitted from Fourfold relation_sha256s are no longer reintroduced by the canonical multi-relation compiler; focused regressions cover matching/discover-all refusal, unrelated selected pruning and retained-edge continuity
